name: Razzia
description: Razzia is a self-hosted, open-source quiz platform for smaller events. A manager hosts a live quiz from the browser while participants join with a room code from their own devices, with quizzes, results and custom branding stored as files in the config folder.

notes.text: The manager password is generated during installation and stored as MANAGER_PASSWORD in /opt/razzia/.env. Open the manager interface at http://<IP>:3000/manager and log in with it. Manager access is refused until MANAGER_PASSWORD is set.

JWT_SECRET in /opt/razzia/.env signs the session tokens and is generated during installation. Leaving it empty makes the server generate a new secret at every start, which logs managers out and gives players a fresh identity on each restart. It must be at least 32 characters; a shorter value is ignored. Restart the service after editing the file: systemctl restart razzia
Quizzes, saved results, uploaded media and optional branding live in /opt/razzia-config (quizz/, results/, media/, branding/). An example quiz is created there on first start.

Game state is kept in memory by the socket server, so only run a single instance. Behind a reverse proxy, WebSocket upgrade headers must be forwarded to port 3000 or clients stay stuck on connecting, and the upload limit must allow 100 MB media files.
